vault.name: OlympiaSovereigntyVault
vault.role: The permanent address consensus credits. No owner, no role, no setter, no parameter. It holds nothing for long: sweep() forwards its whole balance, unchanged, to the Treasury

treasury.name: TimelockController
treasury.role: The Olympia Treasury. Holds the funds and carries out approved proposals after a mandatory delay. Stock OpenZeppelin, and replaceable by governance without a fork

governor.name: OlympiaGovernor
governor.role: Proposal lifecycle, vote tallying, and the execution-time compliance gate. The only account that can tell the Treasury to pay

coreNft.name: CoreNFT
coreNft.role: Soulbound membership. One non-delegable vote per core contributor, minted only by a passed proposal

sanctionsOracle.name: SanctionsOracle
sanctionsOracle.role: The list the Governor screens every outward address against before the Treasury releases anything

ofpRegistry.name: OFPRegistry
ofpRegistry.role: Funding-proposal metadata, bound to the proposal that executes it so voters read what runs
